high_level_description: This image is an advertisement for a pre-order launch of merchandise related to ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation). The ad is sponsored by "indicinspires" as indicated at the top left corner. Main Object: A white T-shirt with a graphic design prominently displayed on it. The design includes the word "ISRO" written in both English and Hindi script. The graphic features a stylized rocket with a lightning bolt, symbolizing space exploration.
